question: Can one Malajanha song be followed back to a printed literary text?
scope: Ga Champu printed source and a qualified identified film excerpt; one Music passage.

findings: Original printed Ga section in Champu Prabesha, pp15–16, contains the refrain and subsequent verses; commentary is distinct.
Modern Wikisource transcription and OdiaSahitya identify Kabisurya Baladeva Rath and Kishore Chandrananda Champu.

An odia melody upload identifies the footage as Malajanha and names Akshaya Mohanty as singer and composer, Kabisurjya as lyricist. The final prose attributes this identification rather than presenting an independently matched original-film sequence.
Several separated automatic-caption stems correspond to the printed poem. They are not used for exact quotation or translation.
